title: Optimum Info- QA Engineer (Manual Tester)
description:
**Role :** Manual QA Engineer

**Location :** Noida

**Job Description :**

Software Testing Engineer

At Optimum Info, we are continually innovating and developing a range of software solutions empowering the Network Development and Field Operations of companies in the Automotive, Power Sports and Equipment industries. Our integrated suite of comprehensive solutions provides a seamless and rich experience to our customers, helping them become more effective at their work and create an impact on the organization.

Our sharp cultural focus on outstanding customer service and employee empowerment is core to our growth and success. As a growing company, we offer incredible opportunities for learning and growth with opportunity to manage high\-impact business solution.

**Position Overview**

A Quality Assurance Engineer at Optimum Info will be responsible for ensuring quality of software product by defining the test plans and strategy, test scenarios, suites and test cases, executing the tests and certifying the software product. A key element is active participation in product development right from product / feature conceptualization through elaboration, development and deployment. You will also create and maintain automated tests, as well as develop procedures used to ensure that programs function according to specifications and conform to established guidelines for new and existing software systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

This list is indicative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. As software development and validation technologies continue to evolve, it is expected that the QA engineer will constantly research, identify and adopt the best tools and practices for ensuring high quality software product releases.

* Develop and maintain a thorough knowledge of the assigned software products and features
* Prepare and maintain test plans and strategy for each product line
* Develop test scenarios and scripts for feature and product testing
* Create, set up, and maintain regression scripts
* Test software with a goal of zero defects on production
* Work with utility programs to test, track, and verify defects in software programs
* Coordinate testing initiatives for releases with the team to ensure all functional areas are thoroughly tested according to Quality Assurance processes
* Develop and implement automated regression testing scripts
* Monitor program release cycles and validate deployments to prevent impact or errors to the production operating environment
* Validate and troubleshoot new builds and post\-production issues
* Define, track and report quality assurance metrics such as defects, defect counts, test results, and test status
* Collaborate with other teams (e.g. business analysts, developers) for continuous quality improvement initiatives

**Desired qualifications and experience**

* A bachelor’s degree in engineering with 2\-3 years of experience with
* Software testing as described in the responsibilities section
* Agile/SCRUM environment
* Development of automated testing frameworks and scripts using tools such as Selenium, UFT, Coded UI etc.
* Configuration management tools like Git, TFS/Azure DevOps etc.
* Alternatively, holders of other graduate degrees with demonstrable equivalent experience will also be considered
* Past experience or passion to grow into an SDET profile

**Certifications**

* ISTQB / certified software tester certifications desirable

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹350,000\.00 \- ₹700,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* What's your present CTC and expected CTC, mention in LPA?
* What's your notice period? What will be your minimum time to join?
* How many years of experience you have in Regression Testing?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* total work: 3 years (Required)
* Manual Testing: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Technology team in Noida. This is an amazing opportunity to work on Clarivate IPMS. (Intellectual Property Management Systems)

 **About You – experience, education, skills, and accomplishments**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or similar engineering or science discipline.
* Minimum 2 years of total experience providing quality assurance to a software development team for a commercial product
* Understanding of test automation frameworks \& assisting/reviewing script creation
* Familiarity with tools like Playwright, Selenium, Cucumber, Junit, Rest \& SoapUI
* Familiarity and clear understanding of Agile \& Kanban development approaches
* Familiarity of working with test and defect management tools like JIRA, confluence.
* Experience in Github.

 **It would be great if you also had . . .**

  

* Experience with AWS or any Cloud environments.
* Good programming skills in various language like Java, Python or .Net
* Working experience and understanding of Jenkins.

 **What will you be doing in this role?**

  

* Develop \& execute, automation \& manual test suites for IPMS applications
* Perform manual testing and create detailed test scenarios and test cases.
* Working with development engineers, architects \& product managers to understand product workflows, requirements \& acceptance criteria
* Creating and maintaining accounts for quality assurance and software development
* Collaborate closely with the development team to clarify requirements, share feedback, and resolve issues quickly

 **About the Team**

  

This role is part of the technology team as part of the IPMS Business segment. Our squads collaborate to build the best\-in\-class software solutions.

 **Hours of Work**

  

This is a full\-time opportunity with Clarivate, 9 hours per day including lunch break.


At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non\-discrimination in all locations.

**MetLife Values :**


**Our purpose and values**


Our purpose is why we are in business and reflects what we stand for and believe in. Our purpose is to *help people pursue more from life*. Our values are how we achieve that purpose, through an expression of who we are, what we stand for as a company and how we conduct our business:

  

**Put Customers First**
  

Caring for and respecting customers is core to everything we do. It defines our work and shapes the culture for our people, radiating out to our shareholders and communities.

  

  

**Be The Best**
  

We are relentless in our search for new and better ways of doing things. As a leader in our industry, we constantly raise the bar, take calculated risks and learn quickly from our mistakes.

  

  

**Make Things Easier**
  

Products in our industry aren't always easy to understand. That's why we are always looking for simpler ways to connect customers to the best solutions. By doing this, we aim to exceed their expectations and build trust.

  

  

**Succeed Together**
  

United by our purpose, we live by a collective commitment to honesty, integrity and diversity. We are open and inclusive, proudly taking and applying the best ideas from every part of our company.

  

  

  

**About MetLife**  

Recognized on Fortune magazine's list of the "World's Most Admired Companies" and Fortune World’s 25 Best Workplaces™, MetLife, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, is one of the world’s leading financial services companies; providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management to individual and institutional customers. With operations in more than 40 markets, we hold leading positions in the United States, Latin America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East.  

As part of our New Frontier strategy, MetLife is building an AI\-enabled, people\-centered future. We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset as we use AI to enhance how we serve customers, support communities, and evolve the way work gets done. At MetLife, AI is a responsible partner that supports human judgment, creativity, and continuous improvement while helping us build trust, inclusion, and long\-term value.  

Our purpose is simple \- to help our colleagues, customers, communities, and the world at large create a more confident future. United by purpose and guided by our core values \- Win Together, Do the Right Thing, Deliver Impact Over Activity, and Think Ahead \- we’re inspired to transform the next century in financial services. At MetLife, it’s \#AllTogetherPossible. Join us!
